prompts.description: Prompts to add or update, at most 2000 per request.

external_visibility.description: Share of answers (0-100) that mention the brand for this prompt, as reported by the tool the prompt set came from. Kept to benchmark against our own citation rate.

prompt.description: The question to ask the answer engines, as a user would phrase it. Matching ignores case and whitespace, so a re-import updates the existing prompt.

topic.description: Theme the prompt belongs to. The runner alternates between topics on each run.
